description: Geolatvija (Latvian state unified geospatial information portal) is a portal or repository of infrastructure or hazard data run by Latvian Geospatial Information Agency. Search summaries name the site as the state unified geospatial information portal of Latvia, next to the open data portal data.gov.lv and the services portal latvija.lv. Coverage: Latvia. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is: not stated; not read. Caveats: the page is drawn by script and returned only the word GEO, so the layers, formats and licence are unverified; the text read does not name the operating agency, which is given here from general knowledge of the portal. It can support finding Latvian base maps and spatial layers for network and hazard studies. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet; the data are reached through the portal page linked here. This record was written from the primary page fetched on 2026-09-30: only the page title and meta description came back (the page is drawn by script); statements come from those and from search result summaries; the data themselves were not downloaded.
